_about: Mark Twain's books for young readers: The Adventures of Tom Sawyer (Hartford, 1876), Adventures of Huckleberry Finn, The Prince and the Pauper, Tom Sawyer Abroad and Tom Sawyer, Detective. Huckleberry Finn prints racial slurs in its characters' speech; it is kept as printed. Added at the coordinator's standing relay (2026-10-02/03: choose public-domain storytellers batches; Adam may veto).
